text:
Alex: Heads-up — PR #25431 (feature/route-reuse) is ready but stuck in mac-e2e + windows matrix. We need to land before the deploy freeze tomorrow 00:00 UTC. Who can help with reruns or a quick rebase?
Maria: On it. Kicking mac + windows reruns now. Will update if anything obvious pops. :coffee:
Jon: I saw a flaky timeout in kv-store integration on my local run earlier. Logs show `kv_test::timeout` at ~30s. I’ll try to reproduce and open a minimal repro if I can.
CI Bot: CI: mac-e2e failed on job 542 — test `kv_test::timeout`. Use `/ci rerun 542` to retry.
Alex: If reruns keep failing we can split the PR: runtime change now, infra tweaks (test flake) as follow-up. Prefer to avoid post-freeze exceptions if possible.
Tess: I can take the Windows rerun in ~2h after lunch. @Jon can you paste the failing command/steps?
Jon: Repro steps: `./scripts/test-kv --filter timeout --repeat 10` — failure ~3/10 locally. Attaching a short log snippet: `ERR: kv_test timeout at step 4/7 (30.2s)`
SRE Oncall: Reminder: there’s a deploy freeze at 00:00 UTC. If we need an exception, file in #eng-releases with `merge-exception` and tag infra/product. Otherwise plan to land before 23:00 UTC to allow rollback window.
Maria: Rerun #542 queued. If it fails I'll try a rebase onto main and re-run to see if CI cache helps.
Jon: Thinking: small increase to the test timeout (-> 45s) might be safer than flakey timing. I’ll try a local push to the branch with that change and mark it as WIP.
CI Bot: CI: mac-e2e rerun (job 542, attempt 2) — SUCCESS ✅
Alex: Nice. Windows still pending — @Tess any updates?
Tess: Windows matrix is failing on a mock timing assertion in `mock_kv.rs`. Running Windows e2e locally now. Quick hack: bumping `sleep_ms(50)` -> `sleep_ms(100)` in test stabilizes it locally. I’ll push a tiny fix to the branch and trigger CI.
Maria: Once Tess pushes, ping me and I’ll help with any merge conflicts from the rebase. If both matrices pass before 23:00 UTC we merge; otherwise open exception like SRE said.
Alex: Agreed. Plan: 1) land if both pass before 23:00 UTC; 2) otherwise request exception with a short risk note and canary plan. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :pray:
Tess: Patch pushed and CI triggered — will report back.
CI Bot: CI: windows-matrix job 918 — FAILED (flaky timing)
Tess: I kicked a rerun for job 918; monitoring.
CI Bot: CI: windows-matrix job 918 rerun — SUCCESS ✅
Alex: Excellent — both green. Maria, can you do the final merge once you confirm no conflicts?
Maria: Doing a quick rebase now, will merge and monitor canary rollout.
Jon: If anything pops, I’ll stand by to revert or hotfix.
Maria: Merged at 1765551886. Pushing canary.
Alex: Closing loop — landed and canary looks healthy so far. Thanks all!
